what: Discovering what is available for download
title: Getting Started
text: flux_listall() R wrapper around command line program, fluxnet-shuttle, requires Python. first time run flux_listall(), Python virtual environment created fluxnet-shuttle installed . don’t appropriate version Python installed, may prompted tips install . default, results flux_listall() saved user cache, run ’ll pull results unless older cach_age. ignore cache, use use_cache = FALSE. invalidate cache (replace updated one), use cache_age = -Inf. list returned flux_listall() contains metadata available sites including, importantly, citations site-level data attribution required FLUXNET.
code: list <- flux_listall() #> virtualenv: fluxnet #> File list is expired, downloading the latest version # Don't use cached results: list <- flux_listall(use_cache = FALSE)  # Invalidate and replace cached results: list <- flux_listall(cache_age = -Inf) colnames(list) #>  [1] "data_hub"               "site_id"                "site_name"              "location_lat"           "location_long"          #>  [6] "igbp"                   "network"                "team_member_name"       "team_member_role"       "team_member_email"      #> [11] "first_year"             "last_year"              "download_link"          "fluxnet_product_name"   "product_citation"       #> [16] "product_id"             "oneflux_code_version"   "product_source_network" list %>% select(site_id, product_citation) #> # title: Getting Started
text: paths downloading FLUXNET data. just want download everything available, simply run flux_download(). can download just specific sites site_ids argument, can filter results flux_listall() pass .
code: # Download everything available. flux_download()  # Download just certain sites flux_download(site_ids = c("AR-CCg", "AR-TF1", "BR-CST"))  # Filter list and download list_wet <- list %>% filter(igbp == "WET") flux_download(file_list_df = list_wet) #> Downloading data from all available sites.

title: Getting Started
text: flux_extract() allows unzip desired files downloaded site .zip files.
code: # Extract everything (not recommended!) flux_extract()  # Extract just annual and monthly data flux_extract(resolutions = c("y", "m"))  # Extract hourly data for just certain sites flux_extract(site_ids = c("AR-CCg", "AR-TF1"), resolutions = "h")  # Don't extract BIF and BIFVARINFO CSVs flux_extract(extract_varinfo = FALSE)

title: Getting Started
text: can read data passing manifest flux_read(). can read data just select sites site_ids argument, complex filtering can simply subset manifest object first.
code: # Read all available annual data annual <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y") #> Reading 10 files. ## NOT RUN ## # Read in hourly data from specific sites hourly <- flux_read(   manifest,   resolution = "h",   site_ids = c("AR-CCg", "AR-TF1") )  # Read in only ERA5 data annual_era5 <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y", datasets = "ERA5")  # Filter manifest to just sites with "WET" for IGBP n_wet_manifest <-   left_join(manifest, list, by = join_by(site_id)) %>%   filter(igbp == "WET", location_lat > 0)  n_wet_monthly <- flux_read(n_wet_manifest, resolution = "m")

title: Getting Started

title: Flag overly-gapfilled data — flux_qc
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{  # Flag rows where NEE_VUT_REF is more than 50% gapfilled manifest <- flux_discover_files() annual <- flux_read(manifest, resolution = "y") annual_flagged <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = "NEE_VUT_REF",   threshold = 0.5 )  # Use multiple variables each with a different threshold for QC annual_flagged2 <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = c("NEE_VUT_REF", "TA_F"),   threshold = c(0.4, 0.6) )  # Same as above, but require *both* variables to be above their thresholds # to consider that row a problem annual_flagged2 <- flux_qc(   annual,   qc_vars = c("NEE_VUT_REF", "TA_F"),   threshold = c(0.4, 0.6),   operator = "all" )  } # }

title: fluxnet 0.5.0
text: flux_qc() now works hourly data supplying threshold 0, 1, 2, 3. max_gapfill argument flux_qc() renamed threshold output flux_read() now includes time_resolution column. may especially useful hourly ("HR") half-hourly ("HH") frequency data, combined resolution = "h".

title: fluxnet 0.3.0
text: Adds new function, flux_install_shuttle() accepts name virtualenv use version fluxnet-shuttle install. pulls envvars, default, making easy configure via project-level .Renviron file. can run separate step, optional called automatically first time flux_listall() flux_download() run. flux_download() longer shows progress bar downloads files. Optionally, can provide list containing Ameriflux user name, email, intended use flux_download() via new user_info argument flux_amf_credentials() helper function. get available sites flux_download(), use site_ids = NULL. site_ids = "" deprecated. flux_download() now uses fluxnet_shuttle Python library rather httr2 perform downloads. Fixed bug flux_badm() cause error “BIF” files contained additional optional columns (#57) use_cache argument flux_listall() removed. flux_listall() gained clean_cache argument set number recent snapshot CSVs keep. Defaults 10.

title: fluxnet 0.2.1
text: Eric Scott now listed package maintainer

title: fluxnet 0.2.0
text: Added flux_varinfo() flux_badm() reading tidying “BIFVARINFO” “BIF” files, respectively. flux_extract() flux_read() gain network argument specify subset networks (e.g. ICOS, TERN) extract data . Suggested @lbell3141. Added flux_qc(), function flag overly gapfilled rows aggregated (hourly) data. Added flux_map_sites(). flux_download() now uses httr2 rather curl downloading files. fixed bug downloads failing attempting download large numbers sites . Added flux_map_sites() flux_download() prints warning downloads fail. Changed default cache age flux_listall() 1 day. flux_download() now retries failed downloads overwrite = FALSE longer skips downloading corrupted partial downloads. Added flux_read() reading FLUXNET data manifest. Added flux_discover_files() creating file manifest.
